answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Appointed river gauger badge with river gaugers verification. It demands a badge gaugers renew after station checks, and the opal is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the horizon compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the beacon is that the farm's unit economics never work.
